intent.raw: Add 2 delivery lanes to the ontologize method: using the tools the client already has, or using Arcanum inventory and ontology.
intent.objective: Run the canonical refine loop with two role-bound lane-designer subagents to add two implementation lanes to the ontologize engagement: Lane A on the client's existing tools and Lane B on Arcanum inventory + ontology-vault + context-builder. Define each lane's four-layer mapping, a selection rule, and the per-vertical candidate lane, reusing local ontologize artifacts and Arcanum skill definitions.
intent.operator_sentence: Add an existing-tools lane and an Arcanum-inventory/ontology lane to the method.

technique_overlays.trigger: Two competing implementation lanes (existing tools vs Arcanum substrate) must be compared on cost vs capability vs sovereignty.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: The two lanes are compared with named roles and convergence criteria (when each lane wins); the result is a decidable selection rule, not a vague preference.

technique_overlays.trigger: How each of the four layers maps onto each lane's concrete tooling is the main uncertainty.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: DELIVERY-LANES.md emits a concrete per-lane four-layer mapping, each element traced to a tool capability or Arcanum skill path or marked hypothesis.

technique_overlays.trigger: Existing ontologize artifacts and local Arcanum inventory/ontology-vault skills are material.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Reuse ontologize design + Arcanum skill definitions; dedup against prior findings; record residue.

route_menu.context_hint: Tournament between two delivery lanes plus x-ray of the layer mapping. Single profile selected.

items.label: Two-lane tournament
items.description: Compare existing-tools vs Arcanum-substrate lanes and define a selection rule.

items.label: Arcanum-only
items.description: Only design the Arcanum substrate lane; ignores clients who cannot adopt new tooling.

steps.name: Context Builder evidence baseline
stop_conditions: Block if the Arcanum inventory/ontology-vault skills cannot be read.

steps.name: Invoke Define the two-lane addition
stop_conditions: Flag if a done-criterion is unaddressed.

steps.name: Research decision
stop_conditions: Ask before any external pass if a named external gap appears.

steps.name: Distill: tournament between the two lanes
convergence_criteria: Each lane's four-layer mapping is concrete and traced to a tool capability or Arcanum skill path.
A decidable selection rule names when Lane A wins, when Lane B wins, and the dominated region.
Cost vs capability vs sovereignty trade-offs are stated, not asserted.
stop_conditions: Block if a lane mapping cannot trace to a real capability or be marked hypothesis.

steps.name: Invoke Redesign to DELIVERY-LANES.md
stop_conditions: Block if the artifact lacks both lanes, the layer mapping, and a selection rule.

steps.name: Distill repair
stop_conditions: Block if a flagged gap cannot be repaired or named as residue.

steps.name: Invoke Plan deltas (lane-selection step)
stop_conditions: Non-executed; flag if deltas are not mapped to existing tasks.

steps.name: Final Interrogation and Refine synthesis
stop_conditions: Block if the done-criteria are not concretely satisfied.

subagent_strategy.trigger: Two genuinely independent design investigations, one per delivery lane, each needing distinct evidence (client-tool integration patterns vs Arcanum inventory/ontology-vault capabilities).
subagent_strategy.explanation: Role-bound lane designers keep the existing-tools lane and the Arcanum-substrate lane from blurring, so the tournament compares two concretely-grounded options instead of one hand-waved blend.
context: The operator asked to add exactly two lanes: existing tools, or Arcanum inventory + ontology.
Lane B must be grounded in the local inventory and ontology-vault skill definitions.

roles.purpose: Design Lane A: install the four layers on a client's existing ERP/TMS/spreadsheet/BI stack.
Design Lane B: install the four layers on Arcanum inventory + ontology-vault + context-builder, grounded in the local skill definitions.

subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: Run the two lane-designer subagents (existing-tools, arcanum-substrate) to design and compare the two delivery lanes?
receipt_requirements: selection criteria where the lane wins

boundaries.contract: ontologize artifacts are the design under refinement; Arcanum inventory/ontology-vault skill definitions are read-only capability evidence cited but not modified.
No external research without operator confirmation; default no-research/local-first.

promotion_splits.target: canonical Arcanum knowledge or client-facing collateral
promotion_splits.rule: requires owner review and a separate promotion route

gates.condition: Every runtime-backed stage names a canonical capability handle.
Every lane layer-mapping element traces to a client-tool capability or a local Arcanum skill path, or is marked hypothesis.
The Lane A vs Lane B selection rule must be decidable from observable client facts, not a vague preference.
GoldenQuill and Arcanum skill definitions are read-only; this run must not modify them.
Each approved lane-designer subagent returns a receipt with its four-layer mapping, selection criteria, and residue before parent synthesis.
Outputs are candidates; no canonical promotion, no pricing/contracts/named clients.
RESULT.md is synthesized from stage artifacts and subagent receipts and confirms the done-criteria.

promotion_guardrails: GoldenQuill and Arcanum skill definitions are read-only evidence.
DELIVERY-LANES.md is a candidate design, not a built system.
No canonical Arcanum promotion; no pricing/contracts/named clients.
